services.liturgy.heading: Divine Liturgy
services.liturgy.body: The Divine Liturgy of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church is celebrated in Ge'ez, the Church's ancient liturgical language, with the readings and parts of the liturgy also given in Amharic. Faithful who plan to receive Holy Communion traditionally observe a fast beforehand.
services.sundaySchool.heading: Sunday School
services.sundaySchool.body: In the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo tradition, Sunday school (ሰንበት ትምህርት ቤት) is where children and youth learn the Christian faith and the traditions of the Church.
services.prayerTeaching.heading: Prayer & Teaching
services.prayerTeaching.body: Beyond the Divine Liturgy, the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church holds prayer services and teaching (ስብከት) grounded in the Word of God.
